variables.ITEM_DESCRIPTION:
Create the new dedicated emulator scenario, using vrooli-emulator as the working scenario name, as a reusable Linux-first validation service.

The implementation should reuse proven concepts from scenario-to-desktop livedesktop and smoketest work, but rehome them behind clean service boundaries so other deployment ramps and deployment-manager can consume one shared emulator app instead of each owning their own ad hoc validation logic.

# Implementation Plan — Retire `execute/vrooli-emulator-linux-first` Umbrella Item

## 1. Purpose

Execute the user's explicit retirement decision from workshop round 1 (d1=B "retire", plus "Archive this backlog item" reinforced on d2, d3, d4, d5). This plan pivots from the prior integration-milestone framing to a focused retirement-and-cleanup plan: rewire the single dependent edge, rehome or explicitly drop orphan deliverables from the prior scope, and formally close this item out without losing Phase 1 readiness signal for the `emulator-platform` initiative.

## 2. Required Reading

```bash
# Swarm Manager data-model and CLI context
prompt-manager skill read swarm-manager-backlog-tools implementation-plan-authoring
```

Repo-specific context:
- `swarm-manager initiatives get --name emulator-platform` — current rollup (13 items, 2 completed, 11 pending)
- `swarm-manager backlog get --kind execute --name adopt-vrooli-emulator-in-deployment-flows` — the **only** dependent edge; must be rewired before this item is closed
- `workshop/round-001.json` — the settled retirement decision this plan executes
- `swarm-manager backlog get --kind research --name emulator-extraction-and-service-plan` — original decomposition into 9 sibling items that made this umbrella redundant

## 3. Problem Statement

This item was originally scoped as an XL "build the emulator Linux-first" umbrella. The research item `research/emulator-extraction-and-service-plan` subsequently decomposed that work into 9 concrete sibling backlog items (scaffold, acceptance tests, UI, external-url, iframe embed, livedesktop removal, smoketest delegation, docs, remote-backend spike), leaving this umbrella with no clear direct deliverables. Round 1 workshop asked whether to integrate, retire, or collapse — the user unambiguously chose retire and reinforced the choice four more times.

Retiring the umbrella cleanly requires three concrete actions:
1. Dispose of orphan deliverables (operational baseline defaults, integration smoke harness, PRD fill-out, runbook) that the prior integration-milestone plan would have owned — either rehome them to an existing sibling item, spin up a new sibling, or explicitly drop.
2. Rewire `execute/adopt-vrooli-emulator-in-deployment-flows.depends_on` so it no longer references this umbrella and instead points at the subset of Phase 1 siblings that actually gate adoption.
3. Remove this item from the active backlog (archive status or delete) so it no longer shows up in queues, rollups, or dependency graphs.

## 4. Scope

### In scope
- Resolve round 2 decisions (d1 orphan disposition, d2 new depends_on set, d3 archive mechanism)
- Apply backlog mutations: dependency rewiring on the one dependent item, optional sibling updates for orphan absorption, status change or deletion of this item
- Verify initiative rollup and grep for stale references

### Out of scope
- Any code, UI, docs, or test work inside `scenarios/vrooli-emulator/` or `scenarios/scenario-to-desktop/` — every emulator deliverable is owned by a sibling item, which the user has explicitly directed should remain separate
- Reopening the retire decision
- Editing other sibling items' plans, workshop rounds, or scopes beyond the minimum needed to absorb any orphan deliverables chosen by d1
- The `archive/` folder on this item — spec mandates it is immutable user-provided context

## 5. Current Technical Context

**Initiative `emulator-platform` rollup** (as of 2026-04-18):
- Total: 13 items (1 research, 10 execute, 2 chore, 1 research-spike)
- Completed: 2 (`research/emulator-extraction-and-service-plan`, `execute/scaffold-vrooli-emulator-scenario`)
- Pending: 11
- All Phase 1 child items that the former integration-milestone plan would have aggregated remain pending

**Dependent edges into this umbrella** — exactly one: `execute/adopt-vrooli-emulator-in-deployment-flows.depends_on` currently includes `execute/vrooli-emulator-linux-first`.

**Orphan deliverables** (work the prior plan would have owned, not covered by any sibling):
- Operational baseline defaults: max concurrent sessions, Xvfb display number range, session TTL, per-session resource ceilings, stale-session janitor config
- Phase 1 integration smoke harness: a scripted end-to-end exercise (e.g., `make phase1-ready`) that stands up the emulator, creates VNC + headless sessions, takes a capture, tails metrics, tears down

**Deliverables with natural sibling homes** (no new item needed):
- PRD.md fill-out → `chore/vrooli-emulator-documentation`
- Runbook → `chore/vrooli-emulator-documentation`
- Per-distro validation → `execute/emulator-acceptance-tests-phase-1` (add distro matrix to its test plan)

**acceptance_allow mismatch note:** The spec's `acceptance_allow` is `scenarios/vrooli-emulator/**, scenarios/scenario-to-desktop/**` — this made sense for the former build scope but no longer matches. Because this item is being archived with zero code changes, the mismatch is inert; leaving `acceptance_allow` unchanged is safe and avoids spurious churn. Addressed explicitly in i2 for the record.

## 6. Target End State

- `execute/vrooli-emulator-linux-first` is no longer in any active state — either `status=archived` or deleted, per d3
- `execute/adopt-vrooli-emulator-in-deployment-flows.depends_on` no longer references this item; new deps (per d2) point at the actual Phase 1 sibling items that gate adoption
- Every orphan deliverable from §5 has an explicit disposition recorded here and in (if rehomed) the absorbing sibling's plan — no silent drops
- `emulator-platform` initiative rollup reflects the retirement and still produces a meaningful Phase 1 readiness signal via sibling completion state alone
- No stale references to `execute/vrooli-emulator-linux-first` remain in other backlog items' `depends_on`, plan.md, or workshop rounds

## 7. Implementation Strategy

### Phase A — Resolve round 2 decisions (workshop round, this file)
1. Settle d1 (orphan deliverable disposition)
2. Settle d2 (new `depends_on` set for `adopt-vrooli-emulator-in-deployment-flows`)
3. Settle d3 (retire mechanism: status=archived vs delete)

### Phase B — Apply backlog mutations
User or agent (user's choice) applies the following, gated on the d1–d3 selections:

4. Rewire dependent item:
   ```bash
   swarm-manager backlog update --kind execute --name adopt-vrooli-emulator-in-deployment-flows \
     --data '{"depends_on":[<new set per d2>]}'
   ```

5. Rehome orphan work (only if d1 chose rehoming; exact call depends on target sibling):
   - If PRD/runbook/baseline land in `chore/vrooli-emulator-documentation`: append to that item's plan.md scope section via `file-upload`
   - If integration-smoke/distro-matrix folds into `execute/emulator-acceptance-tests-phase-1`: append to that item's plan.md scope section
   - If a new sibling is created (d1 option C): `swarm-manager backlog create --data '{...}'`
   - If orphan work is dropped (d1 option D): record the drop in this plan's §11 Risks and (if initiative orchestration-summary exists) note it there

6. Close out this item per d3:
   - Option A (archive status): `swarm-manager backlog update --kind execute --name vrooli-emulator-linux-first --data '{"status":"archived"}'`
   - Option B (delete): `swarm-manager backlog delete --kind execute --name vrooli-emulator-linux-first`

### Phase C — Verify
7. `swarm-manager initiatives get --name emulator-platform` — confirm this item is absent (if deleted) or `status=archived` (if archived); confirm rollup total matches expectations
8. `swarm-manager backlog get --kind execute --name adopt-vrooli-emulator-in-deployment-flows` — confirm `depends_on` reflects d2 resolution
9. Sanity-grep: search the `swarm-manager/{execute,chore,research,fix,ideas}/` data roots for any other reference to `vrooli-emulator-linux-first` — annotate or clean any survivors

## 8. Contract Decisions

### Settled in round 1 (authoritative)
- **Role of this item**: retire. User selected d1=B and reinforced via "Archive this backlog item" on d2, d3, d4, d5.
- **PRD/runbook/operational-baseline ownership here**: none — not owned by this item in any form. Disposition of that work is delegated to round 2 d1.

### Pending (round 2)
- **d1**: Disposition of orphan deliverables (operational baseline defaults, integration smoke harness, PRD, runbook)
- **d2**: New `depends_on` set for `execute/adopt-vrooli-emulator-in-deployment-flows`
- **d3**: Retire mechanism — archive status vs delete

### Prohibited by earlier decisions (do not revisit)
- No dual-run of livedesktop (research Finding 15, still binding on siblings)
- No shared `packages/procmetrics` library (Finding 12, still binding on siblings)
- No reopening the retire decision

## 9. Testing Plan

All verification is mechanical data-model checking, not code testing (no code changes in this item):

1. **Dependent-item rewiring**: `swarm-manager backlog get --kind execute --name adopt-vrooli-emulator-in-deployment-flows` — expected: `depends_on` includes the new set from d2 and does NOT include `execute/vrooli-emulator-linux-first`.
2. **This item's closure**: `swarm-manager backlog get --kind execute --name vrooli-emulator-linux-first` — expected: returns 404 (if deleted) or shows `status=archived` (if archive chosen).
3. **Initiative rollup**: `swarm-manager initiatives get --name emulator-platform` — expected: this item either absent from the list or shown with archived status; total count matches expected; completed count unchanged (still 2).
4. **Grep sweep**: Search for `vrooli-emulator-linux-first` across swarm-manager data roots. Expected: only this item's own files (if archived) or no matches (if deleted) reference it.
5. **Orphan-work evidence (conditional on d1)**: If d1 rehomes to a sibling, fetch that sibling's plan.md and confirm the absorbed scope is now documented there.

## 10. Rollout/Validation Checklist

- [ ] Round 2 decisions d1, d2, d3 all have `selected` values
- [ ] Orphan deliverables from §5 have explicit rehoming OR explicit drop (recorded in §11 and in target sibling's plan.md where applicable)
- [ ] `execute/adopt-vrooli-emulator-in-deployment-flows.depends_on` updated per d2
- [ ] This item closed per d3 (archived or deleted)
- [ ] Initiative rollup verified
- [ ] Grep sweep confirms no dangling references to this item
- [ ] If rehoming applied: target sibling's plan.md shows the absorbed scope

## 11. Risks + Mitigations

| Risk | Likelihood | Impact | Mitigation |
|---|---|---|---|
| Orphan operational-baseline / integration-smoke work silently dropped → emulator ships without ops readiness, adopters hit prod-level bugs | Medium | High | Force explicit decision in d1; if dropped (option D), record as known follow-up in initiative orchestration-summary and in the adopt item's plan so future workshop rounds surface it |
| `adopt-in-deployment-flows` rewired to wrong dep set → starts too early (missing gate) or blocks unnecessarily (over-specified gate) | Medium | Medium | d2 options span comprehensive / integration-focused / minimal; recommendation is comprehensive because adoption is a one-shot gate and under-specifying is harder to reverse than over-specifying |
| Stale references to this item in other backlog plans or archive docs | Low | Low | Phase C grep sweep catches these before closure |
| Initiative rollup loses its Phase 1 readiness signal once this umbrella is gone | Low | Medium | Initiative rollup already derives readiness from per-item status; removing one coordinator item doesn't remove signal — sibling completion is the real indicator |
| User later wants to resurrect the integration-milestone framing | Very Low | Low | Archive (d3 option A) preserves plan + round history; delete would force recreation from memory — recommendation leans archive for this reason |

## 12. Non-goals / Prohibited Patterns

- Do not reopen the retire decision — user was emphatic (5× retire-equivalent responses)
- Do not edit any child-item scope beyond the minimum needed to absorb explicitly-chosen orphan work (d1)
- Do not make code changes in `scenarios/vrooli-emulator/` or `scenarios/scenario-to-desktop/` under this item — acceptance_allow aside, this item has zero code scope
- Do not silently drop orphan deliverables — every orphan gets an explicit disposition
- Do not touch `archive/` on this item or any sibling
- Do not mark this item complete without running the §10 checklist

## 13. Definition of Done

1. Round 2 decisions d1, d2, d3 all carry `selected` values
2. Orphan deliverables have explicit dispositions documented in §5 and §11
3. `execute/adopt-vrooli-emulator-in-deployment-flows.depends_on` rewired per d2 and verified via `swarm-manager backlog get`
4. This item closed per d3 and verified (404 on get if deleted; status=archived on get if archived)
5. `emulator-platform` initiative rollup verified to reflect the retirement
6. Grep sweep confirms no dangling references to `execute/vrooli-emulator-linux-first`
7. If d1 chose rehoming: target sibling's plan.md updated to own the absorbed scope

# Workshop: Finalize Plan Synthesis

## Purpose

Run the final synthesis pass for a non-research backlog item. Incorporate the latest answered workshop decisions into `plan.md`, reassess readiness against the updated plan, and write a finalize round that contains no new decisions.

This skill exists specifically to avoid the stale-plan gap after the user answers the final round. It is not a normal workshop round and must not generate fresh questions.

## Input Context

**Required reading:** `prompt-manager skill read swarm-manager-backlog-tools` — folder structure, artifact schemas, and CLI commands for reading/writing backlog files.

**Required reading:** `prompt-manager skill read implementation-plan-authoring` — canonical plan structure, mandatory sections, quality gates, and guardrails for `plan.md`.

**Required reading:** `prompt-manager skill read plan-skill-discovery` — use the existing required reading already embedded in the plan when synthesizing the final draft.

## Scope

**In scope:**
- Read the current `plan.md`, all prior workshop rounds, `spec.json`, optional research artifacts, and user files
- Incorporate the latest answered decisions into `plan.md`
- Re-score the 5 readiness dimensions based on the updated plan
- Write a finalize round (`workshop/round-NNN.json`) with zero decision items

**Out of scope:**
- Generating new decisions or proposals
- Asking clarifying questions
- Implementing the backlog item
- Writing `handoff/` artifacts directly — swarm-manager derives idea handoff packages later from the finalized backlog state when execution begins
- Modifying `archive/`

<content>
EOF
```

}
```

## Rules

- `items` must contain **only** `info` items. Zero decisions.
